rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: A Java Spring Boot database server that provides secure SQL execution capabilities across multiple database types including MySQL, PostgreSQL, Oracle, SQL Server, and KingBase. Features connection pooling via HikariCP, SQL security checking to prevent dangerous operations, audit logging for all database interactions, and a write confirmation system that previews changes before execution. Includes comprehensive database metadata retrieval and Docker deployment support.
